locked.title: {title} is locked
locked.body: These exercises build on each other in order. Finish the ones before this one first.

colorSync.desc: A colour name flashes in a different ink colour. Tap the colour that matches the WORD or the INK — the round tells you which.
colorSync.why: This trains the classic Stroop conflict — your brain learns to stop reading the word on autopilot and follow the instruction instead. You get just {seconds}s per round, a streak multiplier, and a bonus for fast correct answers. {rounds} rounds per sprint — half ask for the word, half for the ink.

eye-stretch.description: Let's gently extend how far your eyes can comfortably move — a wider range means fewer stops and starts as you read.
eye-stretch.posture: Sit comfortably. Keep your head still — glance gently, then return to center.
eye-stretch.doneLine: Gently done — your eyes have a little more room now.

regression-control.description: Let's practice moving steadily forward, without looking back.
regression-control.posture: Sit comfortably. Follow the lead point forward — there's no need to check back.
regression-control.doneLine: No backtracking needed — that forward ease is exactly what we're building.

reading-speed.description: Let's build a smooth, comfortable reading rhythm.
reading-speed.posture: Sit comfortably. Read each line naturally as it's highlighted — no need to rush.
reading-speed.doneLine: Smooth and steady — that's exactly the foundation we're building on.

fixation-reduction.description: Let's train your eyes to cover the same line in fewer stops.
fixation-reduction.posture: Sit comfortably. Follow the highlighted point — let your eyes jump, not drift.
fixation-reduction.doneTitle: You're covering more ground per glance.
fixation-reduction.doneLine: Fewer stops, same line — that ease will carry into your reading.

eye-span.description: Let's see how much your eyes can take in at once, without moving them.
eye-span.posture: Sit comfortably. Keep your eyes on the center dot — let things appear around it.
eye-span.doneLine: Calm and steady — your glance is widening.

eye-warm-up.description: Let's loosen up your eyes before we begin — relaxed eye muscles move faster and tire less during reading.
eye-warm-up.posture: Sit comfortably. Keep your head still — let your eyes do the moving.
eye-warm-up.doneLine: Nice and easy — your eyes are ready.

rsvp.description: Let's practice recognizing single words at a fixed point, without moving your eyes.
rsvp.posture: Sit comfortably. Keep your eyes still — let each word arrive and go without chasing it.
rsvp.doneLine: That's the skill — recognizing words without anxiety about catching every one.

dotMemory.desc: A group of glowing dots flashes on the grid — remember where they are, then tap them from memory. {rounds} rounds, each a little harder than the last.

wordFlash.desc: Short words flash quickly on the grid. Remember where each one was and what it said, then pick each one.
wordFlash.memorize: Remember the words and their cells.
wordFlash.pickWord: Pick the word you remember for that cell.
wordFlash.tapCell: Tap a cell you remember, then pick its word.

calmBalance.desc: Two opposite energies — heavy Earth & Gold and light Air & Water — pull against each other. Hold “Ground It” or “Lift It” to stop the drift and keep them in balance. {rounds} rounds, each with a tighter balance and a stronger drift than the last.
calmBalance.harmonyLine: {rounds} rounds of Earth, Gold, Air & Water — balanced.

innerVoice.desc: A very fast stream of words — faster than your inner voice can keep up with. 3 quick questions then check what you remember.
innerVoice.perfect: Perfect recall — you caught every key idea, without the inner voice.
innerVoice.solid: Good understanding — most of it stayed with you even at high speed.
innerVoice.again: Worth another try — a few key ideas slipped by at this speed.
innerVoice.streamCompleteScore: Fast word stream complete — you remembered {score}/{total}.

quiz.notQuite: Not quite — the correct answer is shown above.

schulte.desc: A 5×5 grid of mixed-up numbers. Find and tap 1 to 25 in order, as fast as you can.
schulte.why: A quick warm-up for visual focus and side vision before a reading session.

coach.top: Excellent — both accuracy and speed are outstanding.
coach.strong: Strong performance. Your visual processing is getting sharper.
coach.good: Good start. Regular practice builds the skill.
coach.keepGoing: Keep going — it will click with repetition.

rec.increase: Excellent accuracy. Next time each flash is shorter: {ms}ms.
rec.increaseDetail: You are at the {level} level. Keep it steady.
rec.decrease: Taking more time builds stronger recognition. Next time: {ms}ms.
rec.decreaseDetail: Accuracy matters more than speed right now.
rec.again: Another session at {ms}ms will make it stick.
rec.againDetail: Get 70% or more regularly to move up.
rec.different: Great consistency — try a different exercise to train your brain in a new way.
rec.maintain: Good session. Regular practice builds real skill.
